zh.name: 本期值得知道的更新
zh.summary: 用一期主题统领多条独立更新，每页一条消息，固定事实、影响和来源字段。
zh.useWhen: 逐条卡片适合翻页阅读；与现有同页多栏新闻网格区分，风格差异不单独计数。
zh.instructions: 本期范围、各条更新、图片、实际影响及出处
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: News Digest
en.summary: Create an Instagram news carousel using the news digest structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the news digest format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
